# lamejs 1.2.1

MP3 encoding uses the unmodified lamejs library by Alex Zhukov, based on LAME.
- Project: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
- LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
- License: LGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE and https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html)
- Complete upstream npm source: [lamejs-1.2.1-source.tgz](lamejs-1.2.1-source.tgz)
- Unminified browser source: [lame.all.js](lame.all.js)

The browser loads lame.min.js separately; it can be replaced with a compatible build.
